channel.title: Sam — Journal
channel.description: Writing on film, process and the work, by Sam.

item.title: What the lab sent back
item.description: Five rolls came back from the lab wrong, and one of them became a series. A note on keeping the frames you did not plan.

item.title: Shooting Tunis in January
item.description: January in Tunis is not winter, but the light behaves as though it were — low, long, and gone by five.
